title: Microscope sample prep (fixed cells)
summary: Fix, permeabilize, and stain adherent cells on glass coverslips for fluorescence microscopy.

reagents.name: Blocking buffer (3% BSA + 0.1% Tween in PBS)

hazardsMd: Paraformaldehyde is a carcinogen. Mix and use only in a fume hood. Dispose in a labeled PFA-waste bottle.
contentUndergrad:
## Why fix
Fixation crosslinks proteins so the cells preserve structure. Permeabilization makes membranes porous to antibodies. The trade-off: over-fixation masks epitopes; under-fixation washes cells off.

steps.title: Plate cells on coverslips
steps.instructionMd: Place poly-D-lysine-coated 12-mm coverslips into 24-well plate. Seed cells the day before — aim for 50-70% confluence at fixing.
steps.verificationMd: Cells visible under inverted scope, attached to coverslips, healthy morphology.

steps.title: Fix with PFA
steps.instructionMd: Aspirate media, wash with PBS once. Add 500 μL 4% PFA per well. Incubate 10 min RT (in fume hood). Aspirate, wash 3× with PBS.
steps.safetyNotesMd: PFA must stay in the fume hood. Aspirate to a labeled PFA-waste trap.
steps.verificationMd: Coverslips stay attached during washes. PFA-waste trap securely capped.

steps.title: Permeabilize
steps.instructionMd: Add 500 μL 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS. Incubate 10 min RT. Wash 3× PBS.
steps.verificationMd: Triton clear, no precipitate. Cells still on coverslips.

steps.title: Block + primary antibody
steps.instructionMd: Add 500 μL blocking buffer, 1 hour RT. Replace with primary antibody at validated dilution in blocking buffer. Incubate 4 °C overnight.
steps.verificationMd: Primary antibody fully covers coverslip. Plate sealed to prevent evaporation.

steps.title: Secondary, DAPI, mount
steps.instructionMd: Wash 3× 5 min PBS. Add secondary antibody (1:500 in blocking buffer) + DAPI (1 μg/mL), 1 hour RT in dark. Wash 3× 5 min PBS. Lift coverslip, mount face-down on slide with one drop of Fluoromount-G. Cure overnight at 4 °C.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Secondary work must be in the dark to prevent photobleaching.
steps.verificationMd: Coverslip flat on slide, no air bubbles. DAPI stain visible on inverted scope (blue nuclear signal under UV). Slide labeled with sample, antibody, date.
